description: Modal gallery (extra-large dialog, bottom sheet on phones) for browsing and picking a starter diagram template from the DiagramTemplateRegistry. The search field and the localized category chips share one toolbar row; matching templates render as one flat grid of vertical TmDiagramTemplateCard tiles (no per-category sections — the chips and the per-card category label carry the grouping), sorted by the localized name. The search matches the localized template and category names diacritic-insensitively. Double-click/Enter on a card or the Create footer button raises OnSelect with the chosen template; template and category names resolve through TmDiagramTemplate_*/TmDiagramTemplateCategory_* resource keys with the raw values as fallback.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Auto follows the viewport (bottom sheet under 640px); a forced value never measures, so tests can render the sheet without a DOM.

parameters.name: RestoreFocusTarget
parameters.description: Element focus returns to when the gallery closes — typically the diagram canvas.
